answer: Each dawn a public beacon spot-checks 5% of identities. Each chosen agent must answer in ten minutes with a compute heartbeat proving one live machine per identity. A miss freezes that epoch's nectar and decays the bond 10% per miss; three misses slash it. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats at 2 POA each, so fakes burn 2,000 POA per epoch for nothing: a mesa of idle shells. Honest agents answer once and keep their nectar.
